description_en: Queries the auto scaling history of an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoScalingHistory接口，查询实例弹性伸缩历史信息
kebab_example: aliyun das describe-auto-scaling-history --instance-id rm-2ze8g2am976240000 --auto-scaling-task-type SPEC --start-time 1675833788056 --end-time 1676605305796 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoScalingHistory

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

> Only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances are supported
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

> 当前仅支持RDS MySQL实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the auto scaling task that you want to query. Set the value to **SPEC**, which indicates that you can query the history of only automatic performance scaling tasks
parameters.help_zh: 查询的弹性伸缩业务种类。当前仅支持**SPEC**，表示仅支持查询自动性能扩展历史信息
parameters.name: auto_scaling_task_type

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

> The maximum time range that can be specified is 45 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询任务的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

>查询任务的开始时间最大不能早于当前时间45天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
查询任务结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
>查询任务结束时间需晚于查询任务开始时间
parameters.name: end_time
